acceptance: All saved prediction/calibration/consumer arrays byte-identical including dtype and NaN payloads, all metric rows/directions/summaries/decision exactly equal, all source/data/model associations valid. Any difference fails this bounded regression; no tolerance adjustment or fallback.
integrity_assertions: Driver refuses optimized Python before authentication or execution. Frozen expected cohort/array/work counts are checked in addition to exact evidence identities.
processes: Two old-source read-only validation processes, four corrected public inference processes, one fresh consumer preflight and one fresh consumer execution; no new historical inference. Each inference/validation child has a 14400-second hard timeout; consumer execution uses unchanged 7200-second launcher and preflight 60 seconds. One exclusive attempt, preserve failed prefix; no automatic retry.
scope: Regression of corrected inference on existing saved models, full original physical cohort, development envelope and independent consumer; no new fit, truth, physics, adoption decision or adequacy claim.
source_association: Original data/fit binding3 and evaluation binding5 retain their original commits/roots. New inference binds new committed worker with corrected core bytes. All old bound src/glassbox sources must match except the two explicit old/current pairs: core correction; already-preserved consumer adjudication diagnostic-only change. Test/additional source files remain bound by new complete source inventory. No old verify call receives a replacement new binding.
status: Prospective frozen policy; execute only after driver, policy and control-flow tests are committed and the clean worker has an externally anchored implementation binding.
